stemMarkdown: Three pipes A, B and C can fill a tank in 14, 28 and 42 hours respectively. If all three are opened together, how many hours will the tank take to fill? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Combined rate $= \dfrac{1}{14} + \dfrac{1}{28} + \dfrac{1}{42} = 0.130952$ tanks per hour, so the time is $7.6364$ hours.
